directionRules.rhythm: Hold complete thought and reaction; cut at source pauses; no beat-driven speech trimming.
directionRules.speaker: Default: face and hands have priority; one ordinary speech layer.
directionRules.quote: Current spoken phrase replaces ordinary subtitles in a large separate slot.
directionRules.split: 2–3 retained verbatim items, progressive reveal after each is heard; enumeration without invented causal arrows.
directionRules.comparison: Exactly two retrospective quotes; reveal only after both spoken and the current subtitle has ended.
directionRules.transitions: Motivated straight composition cuts on a shared source clock; short frame-driven text entry.
directionRules.sound: Original voice and single continuous quiet song segment, no phrase ducking or pause boost.
directionRules.effects: No random particles, stingers, stock footage, or simulated 3D.
